name: AbraSilver Resource Corp.
description: AbraSilver Resource Corp. is advancing the Diablillos project, one of the world's largest undeveloped, fully-permitted silver-gold deposits located in the Puna region of Salta Province, Argentina. The project holds a Proven and Probable Mineral Reserve of approximately 124 Moz silver and 1.1 Moz gold, supported by a completed Definitive Feasibility Study. The company is in the development stage, targeting first production in 2029.
